validation.method: Every row of the class-I column of the BMF Prüftabelle ('Allgemeine maschinelle Jahreslohnsteuer', printed in each PAP) was recomputed with this engine; the build fails on any difference. The PAP tables assume an employee insured in all branches, PVZ = 1 (childless surcharge), contribution ceilings West, KVZ = the statutory average Zusatzbeitrag of the year. In addition the § 32a tariff was checked for 0 EUR at the Grundfreibetrag, continuity (< 1 EUR) at the three zone boundaries and marginal rates of 42 %/45 % at the top of zones 3/4. The BMF online calculator's programming interface could not be used (access code only shown behind an interactive consent dialog).
